title: Harbour Playmakers
tagline: Grab a trick at the green spots. F uses it.
about: Dusk on the harbour rink. Three against three.
Three minutes on the clock, most goals wins.
F: METEOR. Light your stick, then hold shoot: your shot floors everyone.
Land a body check (RMB) and you go MEGA: twice the size, bump them flat.
Orange arrows burst you. Blue slush drags the puck.
Pass early, then shoot the return as it arrives.
levels: First night on the quay? Rookie Gulls are a step slower.
Know your way round? Pro Gulls hit as a habit.
The harbour wall. All-star Gulls hunt the puck. Beat pro first.
